theorem_title: Guarded ancestor identity for an odd run and even padding
natural_language_statement:
Let $T:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be the shortcut Collatz map: $T(n)=n/2$ for even $n$ and $T(n)=(3n+1)/2$ for odd $n$. Write $T^k$ for its $k$-fold iterate, with $T^0(n)=n$.

Let $e,L,q,r\in\mathbb N$, $q>0$, and $3^{L+1}q=4r+1$. Then

$$
T^{e+L+2}\bigl(2^e(2^Lq-1)\bigr)=r.
$$

This supplies an actual forward ancestor trajectory; no size, residue, or all-root coverage claim is part of the result.
